browser.title: People
browser.introPickerPictures: Select individual pictures to run through the pipeline independently.
browser.introPickerReferences: Select individual pictures to use as references in your next generation.
browser.introShared: People shared with you, grouped by the person who shared them. Use their pictures as references in your own work.
browser.intro: Build a cast of generated people. Keep their identity, explore new looks, and bring them into product photographs.

empty.shared: A place for your shared cast
empty.noMatchesHelp: Try another name or a detail from their description.
empty.sharedHelp: When someone in your organization shares a person with you, their confirmed pictures will appear here.
empty.defaultHelp: Start with a name and a few details. Generate portraits, add different angles, and choose the pictures that fit your next shoot.

browser.newFace: A new face, waiting for a first photograph.
browser.removeProfileBlocked: Pending generations must finish before removing the profile
browser.descriptionPlaceholder: Add appearance, personality, and styling notes to guide their photographs.
browser.name: Name
browser.picturesHelp: Choose the faces and angles you want to reuse.
browser.pendingOne: 1 picture generating or awaiting exact price. Confirmed results appear here automatically.
browser.pendingOther: {count} pictures generating or awaiting exact price. Confirmed results appear here automatically.
browser.pendingUnknown: Your pictures are generating or awaiting exact price. Confirmed results appear here automatically.
browser.failedOne: 1 previous generation could not be completed. You can create a new batch.
browser.failedOther: {count} previous generations could not be completed. You can create a new batch.

photoEmpty.editable: A first photograph is the start
photoEmpty.readOnlyHelp: This person has no confirmed pictures to select yet.
photoEmpty.editableHelp: Generate a portrait from their description, or add a picture from your library.

browser.unlinkNamed: Remove {name} from this person, keeping the library image
browser.pollingPaused: Progress watching is paused. Your generations remain saved.

selection.slots: {count}/{limit} available slots · selections can span people · Shift selects a range
selection.limitPictures: This batch accepts up to {count} pictures. Remove a selection before adding another.
selection.limitReferences: This model accepts up to {count} references. Remove a selection before adding another.
selection.overPictures: Remove some selections. This batch accepts {count} pictures.
selection.overReferences: Remove some selections. The current model supports {count} reference pictures.

createDialog.title: Create a person
createDialog.help: Give them a name and the details that make them recognizable. You can generate their pictures next.
createDialog.descriptionPlaceholder: Appearance, hair, distinguishing features, personal style…

deleteDialog.title: Remove {name}?
deleteDialog.body: This removes the profile and its picture associations. The pictures, generation history, and charges stay in your library.

attachDialog.label: Add pictures to person
attachDialog.title: Add pictures to {name}
attachDialog.help: Your own uploaded or confirmed library images.

shareDialog.title: Share {name}
shareDialog.help: Share the profile and its pictures with an organization member. New confirmed pictures become available to them automatically.
shareDialog.permissions: Can view, download, and use these pictures as references in their own generations. Only you can edit this person, add pictures, generate into the profile, or change sharing.

errors.load: Could not load your people. Try again.
errors.unavailable: This person is no longer available. Their owner may have changed sharing.
errors.loadPictures: Could not load this person’s pictures. Try again.
errors.createInvalid: Give your person a name of up to 80 characters and a description of up to 4,000 characters.
errors.create: Could not create this person. Try again.
errors.saveInvalid: Use a name of up to 80 characters and a description of up to 4,000 characters.
errors.save: Could not save the profile. Try again.
errors.remove: Could not remove the profile. Try again.
errors.removePhoto: Could not remove the picture from this profile. Try again.
errors.attach: Only available pictures from your own library can be added. Shared or unpriced images cannot be attached.
errors.loadSharing: Could not load sharing. Try again.
errors.share: Could not share this person. Choose an enabled member of your organization and try again.
errors.revoke: Could not remove this person’s shared access. Try again.

generator.title: Photograph {name}
generator.intro: Create their first portrait or explore new looks with the same person as a reference. Pictures join this profile once their exact cost is confirmed.
generator.identityHelp: Selected pictures help preserve identity. Click a picture, then Shift-click another to select a range. Different angles and lighting can still vary.
generator.favouritesNotPersistent: Favourites last for this visit because browser storage is unavailable.
generator.maskRequired: This model requires a mask and cannot create person portraits here.
generator.transparentTitle: Supports transparent image output; enable it in model settings.
generator.transparentHelp: For a transparent image, choose Background → Transparent and use PNG or WebP.
generator.tooManyPictures: Choose fewer variations or reduce the model’s number of images. A person batch can contain up to 4 pictures.
generator.tooManyReferences: This model accepts up to {count} reference pictures. Remove some selections.
generator.finalPrice: Final price appears with each picture.
generator.running: This person’s generation is running. You can close the panel; accepted pictures are saved to this profile after price confirmation.
generator.referenceLimited: This model accepts up to {count} identity references. Only pictures that fit were selected.

errors.creditUsedUp: Your credit is used up. Ask an organization owner to add credit.
errors.outstanding: Your previous image prices must settle before another generation can use your credit.
errors.loadModels: Could not load image models. Try again.
errors.invalidRequest: Check the model settings and reference limit before generating.
errors.partial: Some pictures could not be generated. Saved results will appear when their exact price is confirmed.
errors.busy: The generation queue is busy. Try again after the current work finishes.
errors.failed: Could not finish this generation. Refresh the person’s pictures before trying again; accepted work stays in your history.
